kept.quote: The following low-ridership bus stops are proposed to be removed: Dewbourne Avenue, Ardmore Road, Heathdale Road and Barton Avenue.

kept.quote: Note that the proposed priority transit lanes, parking and turning prohibitions and stop removals are part of the ongoing consultation with local Councillors and the public and are subject to change based on feedback received.
kept.summary: The proposed Bathurst Street transit lanes and stop removals, shown on a map that includes Claxton Blvd, are still under consultation and may change.
kept.why_it_matters: The list of stops near Claxton Blvd on route 7 may still change, which could affect where this rider boards.

kept.quote: The proposed Bathurst Street priority transit lanes are expected to yield immediate benefits for transit users while addressing safety and equity concerns.
kept.summary: Staff expect proposed priority transit lanes on Bathurst Street to benefit transit users and address safety and equity concerns.
kept.why_it_matters: Priority lanes on Bathurst could make route 7 trips to Bathurst Station faster or more reliable, and lane changes may alter how the curb works at stops.
